about: Walkable town pieces. Godot axes, metres. Each piece's door faces +Z. '<name>_roof' is the roof alone; '<name>_door<i>' are door leaves, origin on the hinge, open at 'open_yaw' degrees about Y (0 is shut). Collision is built on import from '<name>-colonly'. Marks are Node3D 'mark_<what>': a person there stands at 'at' and looks along +Z turned by 'yaw'. 'spot' is the TownSite kind the piece serves; walls are 'length' long on X with the outside to +Z.
